nodes.label: Endpoint.Supervisor init/1
nodes.desc: Builds the one_for_one tree: config child, warmup child, PubSub, socket children, server children, socket drainers, watchers.

nodes.label: Phoenix.Config (ETS)
nodes.desc: Endpoint configuration lives in an ETS table named after the endpoint; generated config/2 does :ets.lookup, so reads are lock-free.

nodes.label: pubsub_children/2
nodes.desc: Legacy :pubsub key starts Phoenix.PubSub under the endpoint; new apps declare it in application.ex.

nodes.label: socket_children/3
nodes.desc: Reads endpoint.__sockets__/0 and starts each socket module's child_spec, plus PoolDrainer specs for graceful shutdown.

nodes.label: server_children/3
nodes.desc: When :server is set, asks the adapter for child_specs bound to the endpoint config.

nodes.label: Cowboy2Adapter
nodes.desc: Default HTTP adapter exposing child_specs/2; generated apps default to Bandit via the installer.

nodes.label: Phoenix.Socket.PoolSupervisor
nodes.desc: Started per socket via the Phoenix.Socket child_spec; partitions supervisors and registers an ETS ref in Phoenix.Config.permanent.

nodes.label: Endpoint.__before_compile__/1
nodes.desc: Generates socket_dispatch clauses per socket path, defoverridable call: 2 and an overridden call/2 with RenderErrors wrapping.

nodes.label: Endpoint call/2
nodes.desc: Sets script_name and secret_key_base, puts :phoenix_endpoint private, then super(conn, opts) runs the Plug.Builder chain.

nodes.label: RenderErrors.__catch__/5
nodes.desc: Any rescue/catch inside the endpoint chain is rerendered here before the error escapes to the adapter.

nodes.label: socket_dispatch/2
nodes.desc: Pattern-matches conn.path_info per socket and halts with the transport plug; unmatched paths fall through the chain.

nodes.label: CodeReloader call/2
nodes.desc: Plug the generated endpoint declares in dev; opts[:reloader].(endpoint, opts) reloads modules per request, returning a 500 HTML page on error.

nodes.label: CodeReloader.reload/2
nodes.desc: Drives the Mix compiler tasks listed in :reloadable_compilers for the :reloadable_apps before the request continues.

nodes.label: Socket.Transport.code_reload/3
nodes.desc: Socket transports re-run Phoenix.CodeReloader.reload/1 before upgrade when :code_reloader is on.

nodes.label: Router.__before_compile__/1
nodes.desc: Reverses the accumulated phoenix_routes, builds Route.exprs, groups match clauses, verifies plug init callbacks and emits __routes__/__checks__.

nodes.label: Route.exprs/1
nodes.desc: Compiles a route into path match, bindings, dispatch tuple, host match, path_params and the escaped prepare data.

nodes.label: build_match_path/5
nodes.desc: Emits one clause per route returning metadata, prepare, chain and dispatch; pipes are deduplicated into __pipe_throughN__ functions.

nodes.label: __match_route__/3
nodes.desc: Dispatch entry: nil group_by emits one clause per route; :group_by :verb compiles __match_route_VERB__ helpers with a catch-all returning metadata, prepare, a pipe chain and dispatch.

nodes.label: Router call/2
nodes.desc: prepare(conn) tags :phoenix_router and script_name, URI-decodes each segment, then case __match_route__ raises NoRouteError on :error.

nodes.label: prepare/1 (router)
nodes.desc: merge_private with :phoenix_router and the script name; one shared clause for the whole router.

nodes.label: Route.prepare/3
nodes.desc: Merges compile-time params, private and assigns; shared by all routes so large routers compile faster.

nodes.label: Router __call__/5
nodes.desc: Router dispatch start/stop/exception telemetry around the compiled pipe chain and plug.call/2, honouring :phoenix_bypass.

nodes.label: Router pipe-group macro
nodes.desc: Registers the pipe-group name in Scope and hands the accumulated plug list to Plug.Builder.compile, emitting a function named after the group.

nodes.label: Router.plug/2 macro
nodes.desc: Accumulates {plug, opts, true} tuples into a module attribute that the pipe-group macro later compiles; raises outside a declaration.

nodes.label: Compiled pipe function
nodes.desc: The zero-arg function per pipe group; a halted conn short-circuits, otherwise the matched plug.call(conn, plug.init(opts)) runs.

nodes.label: Matched plug.call/2
nodes.desc: Controllers, LiveView mounts or forwarded routers receive the piped conn inside the dispatch try/rescue telemetry block.

nodes.label: Transports.WebSocket call/2
nodes.desc: GET-only plug chain: fetch_query_params, code_reload, transport_log, check_origin, auth token, subprotocol check, then upgrade.

nodes.label: WebSockAdapter.upgrade/4
nodes.desc: Upgrades the HTTP conn to a WebSocket handled by the socket's Transport implementation for the rest of the connection.

nodes.label: Channel.Server.join/4
nodes.desc: Starts the channel process via PoolSupervisor.start_child (opts[:starter]); runs the user's join/3 callback and links the transport.

nodes.label: handle_info dispatch to handle_in/3
nodes.desc: Messages arrive as handle_info; %Message{} events invoke socket.channel.handle_in(event, payload, socket) and phx_leave stops the channel.

nodes.label: Channel.push/3
nodes.desc: Sends an event straight to the transport_pid, bypassing PubSub, for one-to-one client messages.

nodes.label: Channel.reply/2
nodes.desc: Answers a request/response ref tuple {transport_pid, serializer, topic, ref, join_ref} with a status and payload.

nodes.label: Channel.broadcast/3
nodes.desc: Delegates to Phoenix.Channel.Server.broadcast/4 with the socket's pubsub_server, encoding a Phoenix.Socket.Broadcast.

nodes.label: Server.broadcast/4
nodes.desc: Builds %Broadcast{topic, event, payload} and hands it to Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast; deliveries land back in handle_info.

edges.label: HTTP process invokes the endpoint plug
socket path match halts into transport
dev-only plug declared before the router
clause returns metadata, prepare, chain, dispatch
one function clause per route group
transport joins a topic -> channel process
